questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can amounts differ from member to member, and can one member pay more than once in the same round?
Do you choose who collects each round freely, or is there a set order of collectors decided at the start?
Must rounds go strictly one after another, so nobody can pay into round 3 until round 2 has been collected?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
